description: NextSpark consumer project - root-first source and local plugins

core.message: Core is installed via npm (node_modules/) and cannot be modified. To customize behavior, create a theme override or plugin instead.

app.message: Modifying /app directly is discouraged as it reduces portability. Use theme page overrides when possible. Only proceed if user explicitly requests and understands the trade-offs.

notes.gettingStarted: The directory containing nextspark.config.ts is the project and source root.
notes.creatingPlugins: Use /create:plugin to scaffold a local plugin under plugins/.
notes.needCoreChanges: If you need functionality not available in core, create a plugin or request the feature in NextSpark repository.
